Leah: Quick finalization thread for the webinar runbook. Need: final slot order, who owns failover, rehearsal times. Reply with one-line ack or change.

Ava: Speakers confirmed: Sarah + Miguel. Oliver verbally in; will need slides by Wed noon. Design will produce a single-page benchmark infographic (slide + landing).

Priya: Recommend 15/25/20 split (short keynote, longer demo). I will author the 50-token demo prompt and expected outputs for repeatability.

Ravi: I'll own demo failover toggle and a tiny scrub script to clear env before show. Plan: Dedicated -> Hosted (quantized) -> EU warm cache. Will push scripts to /rehearsals/demo-fallbacks.

Tom: Add a 2-min poll after keynote (PoC / Scaling / Security) to aid SDR routing.

Ethan: I'll moderate the panel and confirm SDR routing. Routing: regs -> SFDC campaign "webinar-march-26"; demo clicks map to SDR queues by ARR band. Ops?

Ops: Confirmed. Zoom->SFDC mapping set; we will tag "interest_level" and "demo_click". Will create queues for ARR >100k vs others. Recording retention 90 days.

Leah: Run-of-show draft (mins):
0:00-0:02 Welcome (Leah)
0:02-0:17 Keynote (Sarah)
0:17-0:42 Live demo (Miguel + Ravi)
0:42-0:56 Panel (Oliver, Sarah, Miguel)
0:56-1:00 Close + CTA (Leah + Ethan)

Ava: Proposed rehearsals: Tue 4pm PT tech check (30m), Wed 9am PT full dress (60m), Thu 9:45am PT mic check (15m).

Leah: Action items: Ava: infographic + chase slides (Mon EOD). Priya: prompt + outputs (Fri). Ravi: failover + scrub (Wed). Ethan/ Ops: routing mapping (Tue). Speakers: consent + slides (Wed noon).
